title: Santoshi Maa
desc: Poulomi Devi is shocked when Lord Brahma asks Santoshi Maa to plough Dev Vatika along with her; Riya is happy as Kranti Maa has approved her marriage to Dhairya.

title: Santoshi Maa
desc: Daksha and Madhu refuse to participate in the haldi ceremony. Meanwhile, Santoshi Maa, Gaumata and three other goddesses arrive on Earth to participate in the event.

title: Santoshi Maa
desc: Daksha falls while trying to destroy the decoration; Poulomi Devi possesses Daksha, and Madhuri tries to cure her.

title: Jodha Akbar
desc: Decoding a missive from Benazir to her mother, Jodha confirms the plot against Jalal's life. Subsequently, her confrontation with Benazir proves fruitless, yielding no admission of guilt.

title: Jodha Akbar
desc: Trailing Benazir, Jodha observes her ingesting snake venom and hears her plan to use the poison to murder Jalal. Jodha hurries to Jalal with this information, but Ruqaiya intervenes.

title: Jodha Akbar
desc: Jalal does not trust Jodha, yet consents to have Benazir assessed. Later, he calls Benazir and the others to the court, where Benazir is found not guilty.

title: Jodha Akbar
desc: Maham Anga orders her soldiers to spread the news throughout Agra that Benazir is a Visha Kanya. Meanwhile, Ruqaiya refuses to believe that Akbar is falling for Jodha Bai despite her many errors.

title: Jodha Akbar
desc: Ruqaiya and Maham Anga hope that Akbar's arranged marriage to Benazir will drive Jodha Bai away from Agra once and for all. Meanwhile, Jodha Bai is in tears and wants to protect Akbar from Benazir.

title: Vasudha
desc: Megha promises to set Karishma free from jail, while Devansh gives his consent to get engaged with Megha for Chandrika. However, this action leaves Vasudha heartbroken, causing her to question him.

title: Saru
desc: Anika's confession earns Chandrakant's wrath. Further, as police arrive to apprehend her, Annapurna intervenes, naming Saru as the true culprit.

title: Jagriti - Ek Nayi Subah
desc: Solanki informs Kalikant about Geeta's return to Mokshagarh. Meanwhile, Ballu schemes to murder Harish on Kalikant's orders, sending Harish tumbling into an abyss.

title: Bhagya Lakshmi
desc: Lakshmi and Harleen's meeting leaves the latter in an emotional state. Later, Lakshmi faces Rishi's outburst as he blames her for taking away his identity as a father while Karishma insults Shalu.

title: Bhagya Lakshmi
desc: Karishma blames Lakshmi for chasing Rishi's money and argues with Rishi about her. Later, Lakshmi refuses to get a DNA test for Parvati after Karishma suggests it, but Rishi goes further anyway.

title: Bhagya Lakshmi
desc: Lakshmi wants to hide the truth while Kiran gives Mallishka advice about the report. Later, Parvati says something to Lakshmi after Harleen declares Parvati as her granddaughter.

title: Bhagya Lakshmi
desc: Malishka arrives at the hospital to tamper with medical documents, just as Lakshmi enters. Later, Lakshmi is stunned upon seeing the reports.

title: Bhagya Lakshmi
desc: Neelam discloses a DNA report refuting Parvati's connection to Rishi. Later, Lakshmi confides in Shalu about falsifying the results, unaware that Malishka lurks within earshot.

title: Bhagya Lakshmi
desc: Rishi instructs Aayush to perform a task after learning Parvati's full name. Later, Aanchal, Neelam's sister, arrives at the Oberoi House.

title: Bhagya Lakshmi
desc: Aanchal introduces herself to Lakshmi as Parvati informs Neelam about not visiting the village. Later, Rishi angrily confronts Lakshmi for not telling him the truth.

title: Bhagya Lakshmi
desc: Harleen and Aanchal quarrel as Aanchal comments on Lakshmi's upbringing while Lakshmi assists injured Rishi. Consequently, Rishi speaks to Lakshmi about her prior pregnancy.

title: Bhagya Lakshmi
desc: Rishi politely inquires of Lakshmi regarding their bond, yet she clearly states that they lack mutual compatibility. Furthermore, Aayush converses with Shalu while Malishka observes them.

title: Bhagya Lakshmi
desc: Malishka grows furious upon witnessing Lakshmi and Rishi together. Later, Neelam orders Lakshmi to leave after Parvati refuses to depart the Oberoi House.

title: Jaane Anjaane Hum Mile
desc: Reet stays vigilant at the party, wary of danger to Raghav. Meanwhile, Unnati's scheme backfires, aiding Reet's investigation as she confronts Viren with new evidence.

title: Vasudha
desc: During Devansh and Megha's wedding ritual, Karishma brings bad luck. Further, she reacts angrily to Avinash's gesture for Divya while Vasudha becomes lost in thought.

title: Saru
desc: Annapurna disowns Saru, calling her a liar and denying kinship. Bewildered, Saru vows to depart, sparing her grandmother further distress.
